The evidence provided is of low quality and low relevance to the specific claim that investing in stocks is the best way to build wealth for retirement. The text explicitly notes that the cited historical market returns were not adjusted for inflation, economic downturns, or individual risk profiles. These omissions significantly undermine the validity of the argument, as they ignore critical factors that affect real-world investment outcomes. Therefore, the evidence fails to robustly support the claim and may even suggest the opposite due to its methodological flaws.
